note: Copy to $AI_ROOT/config/moteur.json. type = ollama | llama-server (any OpenAI-compatible local server). base_url must be a loopback address. api_key_file is optional. models maps the routing ladder to the names your engine exposes. ram_gb = memory each model takes once loaded (measure it), keep_free_gb = memory that must stay free: ia-run refuses to start otherwise.
